regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your kind favor - duly received and noted. I do hope you all keep well - avoiding worry and too much ambition. .... Fr. E'd was down a couple days at Christmas, seems to have enjoyed visit. Am writing him Tonight - his Name day is the 139 E'd.

regions.merged_text: Love and God's blessing to all - special of course to Owen B. J. and B.M. and to Brother Pat. and poor, dear Genevieve.
